title: DREAM — Robotics research
summary: Exploring robotic manipulation in simulation at the Royal Military Academy.
overview: My current research internship sits within DREAM, a programme investigating robotic exploration, mapping and manipulation. My focus is robotic manipulation in simulation.
constraints: Clutter, incomplete observations and interactions between objects motivate the research direction.
contribution: I am carrying out a robotics research internship at the Royal Military Academy in Brussels.
approach: The research connects simulated manipulation tasks with the longer-term question of transferring robot behaviour to physical hardware.
results: The work is in progress. This page introduces its scope rather than claiming a completed sim-to-real result.
limits: Simulation results and physical validation need to be distinguished throughout the project.
